data: In the bottom left graph, is the blue line higher than the red line at the X-axis value of 80?

The question asks whether the blue line is higher than the red line at the X-axis value of 80. From the caption, we know that the X-axis represents the percentage of the original text, and the Y-axis represents AKE metrics. The blue line corresponds to P - SP 10, and the red line corresponds to P - SP 20. 

Looking at the bottom left graph (subfigure (a)), we can see that at the X-axis value of 80, the blue line (P - SP 10) is indeed higher than the red line (P - SP 20). Therefore, the answer is yes.
